Namaste.

reviews.text:
I LOVE this Virtual Live Yoga Classes App! Simple, useful, free classes!. Whether you are beginner or intermediate or advanced or if you have an injury that prevents you from working out this app is truly for everyone! I have been using this app for two months now and I’m just amazed at all of the FREE group classes that MyYogaTeacher has provided as a part of their Covid relief efforts. 

This app has yoga classes almost every hour I would say dozens of classes available throughout the day to fit your schedule.
Not only that but they offer many different types of yoga styles that are simply unavailable here where I live. Most cities, hatha, vinyasa, ashtanga or hot yoga are the only offerings because they are popularAnd because of the expertise of the other types of yoga is very difficult to find. But with this app I have been able to experience a range of different types of yoga such as meditation, Yoga Nodra (sleep yoga), yoga for back pain, yoga for flexibility, chair yoga, hatha yoga, powe yoga, yoga for women, yoga for hormonal balance, yoga for awareness, ashtanga yoga, Yoga for boosting immunity, kriya/pranayama yoga, yoga for kids, yoga for stress and anxiety, and recently I see that they’ve added Zumba and HIIT! 

The teachers are just so well-trained as you can see through their profilesWhich show their years of experience, there were areas of focus and a video of why they came in to Yoga. The teachers are also consistent in their teaching methodology-they explain the benefits of every pose, and they really focus on getting students to attain proper form. These are not teachers that are trying to get a work out at the same time as you. They are looking at the video to watch you and correct you and help you make sure you’re doing the correct pose! These teachers have been trained at renowned yoga institute in India. They have such a loving way of speaking to their students. 

I can’t say enough about these classes.They’ve really changed my life. I suffer from sciatica pain and the traditional Vinyasa classes that I’ve been going to at my studio actually have exacerbated the pain. I take a yoga for flexibility and yoga for back pain class that have reduced my pain significantly so that I can go throughout my day without that pain. 

I have also done the one-on-one sessions which are even more beneficial when combined with the group classes. You get that personalized instruction and get to ask so many questions and develop a working relationship with your yogi guide. I had Vineetha SharmaAnd she just seem to intuitively know exactly what I needed to help my body heal. She took it easy to begin with and then built up on it each class showing me new techniques and taking my feedback and incorporating it.

And that is the other thing after every class you get a pop-up that asked you for feedbackAnd to me it seems that the teachers are really take that feedback they constantly ask for it and want to know and check in to see how we’re doing- they really care!It seems that they are doing this really to help others not for any monetary or other game. You get that feeling when you take the class. 

The app is super simple to use and very user-friendly. You just with one click book a class. Every day there are is a list of classesAnd when you click one step further you can see the entire description of the class as well as the teacher teaching it and if you click on the teacher you can see the teacher profile. So all of the information is right there. Including the time of the class and duration.There’s no limit to the amount of classes you can book in a day and you can book classes even weeks ahead of time which is great! You get a reminder in email and it is alsoAutomatically integrated with Google calendar so it shows up on my calendar! Also you miss a class there’s no penalty.I really have to give credit to the developers/ designers of this app -you’ve really gone above and beyond to make this a perfect user experience! I have critiqued a lot of apps and this is definitely the best of the apps out there. 

While there are tons of YouTube videos out there you can get for free - and I did this before finding this app- but this is different because it’s a live zoom meeting where you feel a part of some thing. Also I have found that even though it’s zoom I have found very little interruption in service maybe once it is happened for a couple minutes but then was totally fine.

I highly recommend anyone especially people with pain or limitations or injuries,And especially anyone that’s really interested about Yoga and wants to experiment with different classes. I would be shocked if there wasn’t a class that you fell in love with. There’s just so many options. I’m very grateful to my yoga teacher for this app it has been a life changer for me ! ❤️🧡💛💚💙💜
